aboutText: Power Street Electrics has been serving Williamstown and the wider Melbourne area for years, providing comprehensive electrical solutions. Our team specialises in installations, maintenance, breakdowns, fit outs, emergency lighting, test and tagging, and specialised floodlighting. We are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality work for both residential and commercial clients. With a focus on safety and efficiency, we handle all electrical needs from routine maintenance to complex fit outs. Our experienced electricians are fully licensed and insured, ensuring peace of mind for every project in Williamstown and surrounds.
servicesText: At Power Street Electrics, we offer a full range of electrical services tailored to Williamstown homes and businesses. From installations and maintenance to emergency repairs and specialised lighting, our skilled team delivers prompt and professional results every time. Our services include electrical installations, routine maintenance, urgent breakdown repairs, custom fit outs, emergency lighting systems, comprehensive test and tagging, and specialised floodlighting projects.
